_note: Per-candidate confirmation that a weekly-RSI>60 entry is riding a real, strong trend - not a choppy spike the lagging weekly-wick-vs-SMA20 exit won't catch until it's already several percent underwater. mode 'rank' (default) only affects tiebreaks for a free slot; mode 'filter' hard-excludes any candidate scoring below min_score, same contract as config/filters/quality.json. Disabled by default - backtest against your own history before enabling, and consider starting in 'rank' mode to see its effect on ranking before switching to a hard 'filter' gate. Scoring is now (2026-10-27, second iteration) a cross-sectional PERCENTILE of each sub-check's raw value against the same metric computed for the full universe that day (see prepare() in trader/filters/trend_strength.py) - replaced a first attempt that used a fixed score_ceiling/score_ceiling_pct, abandoned the same day once the equivalent fix in sector_regime.json demonstrably failed to resolve the mass-tie problem in a real backtest (a fixed absolute ceiling is regime-dependent: too easy to clear in a strong bull market, too hard in a weak one). sector_map_path reuses rs_rank's own universe source. The pass/fail gate itself (min_adx/buffer_pct) is unaffected by any of this - only the ranking score.
